# eclipse-ide

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 31.

## buildProjects

Run an Eclipse incremental or full build and wait for completion. Builds requested projects and their dependencies, plus dependent projects by default. Returns per-project error/warning counts and problem locations. Timeout includes scheduling wait and requests cancellation; incomplete builds are errors. Compiles saved resources, not unsaved editor changes.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectNames | string | String | No | Comma-separated project names; omitted builds all open projects |
| buildKind | string | String | No | incremental (default) or full |
| includeDependents | boolean | Boolean | No | Also build projects transitively referencing the requested projects (default: true) |
| timeoutSeconds | integer | Integer | No | Maximum wait including scheduling, from 1 to 3600 seconds (default: 120) |
| maxProblems | integer | Integer | No | Maximum problem details, from 1 to 500 (default: 100); totals are always complete |

## createDirectories

Creates a directory (and any missing parent directories) within a project. Useful for creating package structures or resource folders.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | Yes | The name of the project where directories will be created |
| directoryPath | string | String | Yes | The directory path relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/newpackage') |

## getCompilationErrors

Retrieves compilation errors and problems from the workspace or a specific project. Can filter by severity level.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project to check (optional, if not specified checks all projects) |
| severity | string | String | No | Filter by severity level: 'ERROR', 'WARNING', or 'ALL' (default: 'ALL') |
| maxResults | string | Integer | No | Maximum number of problems to return (default: 100) |

## getJavaDoc

Get the JavaDoc for the given compilation unit.  For example,a class B defined as a member type of a class A in package x.y should have athe fully qualified name "x.y.A.B".Note that in order to be found, a type name (or its top level enclosingtype name) must match its corresponding compilation unit name.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fullyQualifiedName | string | String | Yes | A fully qualified name of the compilation unit |

## getMethodCallHierarchy

Retrieves the call hierarchy for a specified method, showing which methods call this method (callers) and which methods this method calls (callees).

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fullyQualifiedClassName | string | String | Yes | The fully qualified name of the class containing the method |
| methodName | string | String | Yes | The name of the method to analyze |
| methodSignature | string | String | No | The signature of the method (optional) |
| maxDepth | string | Integer | No | Maximum depth of the call hierarchy to retrieve (default: 3) |
